title: RegistrationPageEntry
description: A registration page entry within the index, covering a range of package versions.

@id.description: The URL to the registration page.

count.description: The number of registration leaves in the page.

items.description: The array of registration leaves. Present when leaves are inlined into the index, absent when a separate request is needed.

lower.description: The lowest SemVer 2.0.0 version in the page (inclusive).

parent.description: The URL to the registration index. Only present when items are inlined.

upper.description: The highest SemVer 2.0.0 version in the page (inclusive).
